verdict.rationale: React's core model (state + re-render on change via useState/props, virtual DOM diffing) is core to its identity, supported by docs on state updates and community discussion of its efficient change-management/DOM diffing implementation. However, the evidence pack lacks explicit detail on fine-grained dependency tracking or scoped re-rendering (React re-renders components, with reconciliation limiting actual DOM changes, but this nuance isn't well documented in the pack).
